mapper.select: SELECT rr.PRODID prodid, rr.SYS_FILENAME sysFilename, rr.FILENAME filename, rr.REVEAL_STATUS revealStatus, to_char(rr.REVEAL_END_DATE revealEndDate,'yyyy-mm-dd') FROM REP_REVEAL rr WHERE rr.STATUS = 'E' AND to_char(rr.REVEAL_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{data,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select DISTINCT prodid,reportCategory from (SELECT DISTINCT rr.PRODID prodid, rr.REPORT_CATEGORY reportCategory FROM REP_REVEAL rr WHERE rr.STATUS = 'E' AND to_char(rr.REVEAL_END_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{data,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND rr.REVEAL_STATUS = #{revealStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT rild.PRODID prodid, ri.REPORT_CATEGORY reportCategory FROM REP_INSTALL_LOG_DETAIL rild LEFT JOIN REP_INFO ri ON rild.REP_ID = ri.REP_ID WHERE rild.STATUS='E' AND rild.EXEC_STATUS='02' AND to_char(rild.REVEAL_END_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{data,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
